system.description:
ARCHIVIST AUDITORY ENCHANTMENT MENTAL SAVE
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (verbal)
Range 60 feet
Targets 1 creature that can hear and understand you
Saving Throw Will
Duration See text

You deliver a formal condemnation in language carrying centuries of theological authority.
Critical: The target is unaffected.
Success: The target becomes Frightened 1 until the end of its next turn.
Failure: The target becomes Frightened 2 and cannot use Reactions until the end of its next turn.
Fumble: The target becomes Frightened 3, cannot use Reactions and becomes Dazed 1 until the end of its next turn.
Word of Censure is supernatural condemnation, not supernatural judgement. It provides no information concerning guilt, morality, ethics or whether the target actually deserves censure.

Warping Options:
+4 PP: Affect one additional creature within 30 feet of the original target.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
